items.quote: Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
items.claim: The servant expresses concern that the woman may not be willing to follow to Abraham's land and questions whether to bring the son back

items.quote: Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again
items.claim: Abraham commands the servant not to bring his son back to the origin land
